creature_families.label: Animal-like families
creature_families.note: DBC-derived creature families, category only; names not repeated

creature_families.label: Creature types
creature_families.note: beast, dragonkin, demon, elemental, giant, undead, humanoid, critter, mechanical, unspecified, totem

creature_families.label: Elite tiers
creature_families.note: normal, elite, rare-elite, world boss, rare (plus unknown sentinel)

top_creatures.label: Rare roamer
top_creatures.why: a rare tier that walks in the open, so an encounter is a surprise
top_creatures.keep: a separate rare tier as a data flag
top_creatures.change: our tell is a short aura and a sting; our own look

top_creatures.label: Wedge breather
top_creatures.why: a front cone with a data-set angle is a readable telegraph in a 375-wide view
top_creatures.keep: angle from a table per attack; a negative value flips to the back side
top_creatures.change: our angles; wedge drawn on the ground before the attack (0.8 s is our proposal, not from the code)

top_creatures.label: Phased guardian
top_creatures.why: boss phases are data: encounter rows keyed by map and difficulty
top_creatures.keep: encounter credit by creature or spell; last-encounter flag per instance
top_creatures.change: our phase triggers and HP steps live in zone data

top_creatures.label: Hate-holding brute
top_creatures.why: a melee brute keeps its target until another player is clearly ahead on threat
top_creatures.keep: switch only at 1.1 times threat in melee or 1.3 times at range
top_creatures.change: MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 and a visible hate marker

top_creatures.label: Model-sized brute
top_creatures.why: reach and speed per model are data, so a big model reads big
top_creatures.keep: per-model combat reach and speed as data

classes.label: Plate melee
classes.progression: 60 levels per class (class level stats: 540 rows = 9 classes x 60 levels)

weapon_families.label: Bow, gun, crossbow, thrown, wand (ranged families)
Staff, fist, dagger, exotic, misc, fishing pole, obsolete

gear_tiers.label: Quality ladder, 7 tiers (poor to artifact)
gear_tiers.note: drop rate per tier looked up in config (LootMgr.cpp:387, config 40-46); colour names only in enum comments; the client is not in the box

gear_tiers.label: Cloth to plate material ladder
gear_tiers.note: armour subclasses: cloth, leather, mail, plate; off-hand buckler and shield; relic libram, idol, totem

gear_tiers.label: Set bonus by piece count
gear_tiers.note: up to 8 spell slots per set

zones.label: Dungeon (instance map)
zones.note: instance_template 32 rows; ghost return point and mount flag per instance

zones.label: Weather walk per zone
zones.note: four types, grade 0 to 1 in three bands; seasons in 91-day blocks

looks.label: Front and back wedge
looks.technique: cone angle from a table; negative flips to back; back is complement of a wide front arc

looks.label: Vertical allowance for area hits
looks.technique: height band shrinks with distance from centre; NPC caster on player targets gets full height; 3D slab test for ground telegraphs

looks.label: Weather intensity states
looks.technique: grade into light, medium and heavy states per type plus fine below 0.27; drives fog, rain or snow visuals

looks.label: Per-model hitbox data
looks.technique: bounding radius and combat reach per model as data

originals.name: Wedge Breath
originals.idea: a creature front wedge with an angle from data, drawn on the ground before the attack
originals.keep: data-set front angle; back wedges by sign
originals.change: our angles; telegraph drawn before the attack; server-verified hit (rows 4 and 13)

originals.name: Hate Anchor
originals.idea: an elite brute that holds its target until a rival is clearly ahead on threat
originals.keep: sticky target; switch at 1.1 times in melee, 1.3 times at range; taunt wins
originals.change: MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; hate marker on screen (rows 4 and 5)

originals.name: Walkers' Weather
originals.idea: zone weather as a walk over three intensity bands with a season
originals.keep: the walk; 30 percent hold; three bands; seasons
originals.change: one band table for logic and visuals; the fair branch returns cleanly (rows 16 and 23)

originals.name: Ghost Walk
originals.idea: death sends the hero to a per-zone return point, with a sickness that scales with level
originals.keep: per-zone return point as data; level-scaled sickness
originals.change: sickness in seconds with a short damage ramp, not a long debuff (rows 17 and 18)

originals.name: Pool of Wanderers
originals.idea: a spawn pool with a limit that refills as members fall
originals.keep: limit minus alive; refill on death
originals.change: retries until the pool is full; a real CanSpawn gate (row 23)

originals.name: Rare Roamer
originals.idea: a rare tier that spawns seldom and pays more
originals.keep: rare tier flag; better reward for it
originals.change: our tell (aura and sting) and our reward table (rows 18 and 12)

originals.name: Set Pieces
originals.idea: gear sets whose effects unlock by piece count
originals.keep: thresholds by piece count; up to 8 effects
originals.change: our steps and our effects (rows 15 and 18)
